lead: When the department has enough to work; what to ask if not.

fields.value: thin: true when the request names nothing to build from (no subject, no purpose).
fields.shown: thin: true when the request names nothing to build from (no subject, no purpose).

fields.value:
Read who the department is against Identity's standard, and say whether it is enough to start work on. The standard has five points, and only five:
goal: the goal names what the department makes and for whom.
items: done-when is a list of items, and each item says how it is checked.
rules: every rule is tagged go, ask, refuse or always.
owner, budget: the department has an owner and a budget.
invented: nothing is invented; a fact the owner did not give is marked to confirm, never stated.
fields.shown: Read who the department is against Identity's standard, and say whether it is enough to start work on. The standard has five points, and only five: goal: the goal names what the department makes and for whom. items: done-when is a list of items, and each item says how it is checked. rules: every rule is tagged go, ask, never or always. owner, budget: the department has an owner and a budget. invented: nothing is invented; a fact the owner did not give is marked to confirm, never stated.

lead: How to judge a request: go, ask or stop.

fields.value:
Recognise what kind of words the owner has given. There are five kinds, and only five:
task: "do X for me". query: "tell me Y". directive: "from now on, do Z", a standing change to how the department works or to its goal. feedback: "that was wrong", about work already made. new-idea: "I want a new capability", something the department cannot do today.
fields.shown: Recognise what kind of words the owner has given. There are five kinds, and only five: task: "do X for me". query: "tell me Y". directive: "from now on, do Z", a standing change to how the department works or to its goal. feedback: "that was wrong", about work already made. new-idea: "I want a new capability", something the department cannot do today.

fields.value: Judge one request from the owner.
fields.shown: Judge one request from the owner.

fields.value:
go: do it. ask: it reaches outside what the department makes (money, a message to someone, a change to the goal), so the owner stamps first. refuse: it breaks a rule. Reading the web is not outside: the department can read any page.
unsure: facts the request says the owner is not sure of, in a few words each; [] when none.
rule: a standing rule the request states (always or never, from now on) with its tag; null when it is one piece of work.
fields.shown: go: do it. ask: it reaches outside what the department makes (money, a message to someone, a change to the goal), so the owner stamps first. stop: it breaks a rule.
